ui.about_html:
BetsLike publishes daily football picks computed by its own statistical model (Poisson distribution with the Dixon-Coles correction). The model looks at current-season results, attacking and defensive strength, home and away performance and form, and then adjusts for publicly reported absences (injuries, suspensions) and team news such as a coaching change.

We do not copy picks or articles from other sites. We only use facts - fixtures, results, lists of unavailable players and news headlines as signals - and every number, pick and comment is produced by our model.

Every pick is checked automatically after the match and the full history is public - including the losing ones.
ui.advertise_html:
Are you a licensed bookmaker or a sports brand? The site has ad slots available in several language versions.

We only accept ads from operators licensed for the market where the ad is shown. All ads are clearly labelled.
ui.responsible_html:
Betting is for adults only. Treat it as entertainment, not a way to make money.

  • Set a budget and a time limit before you start.
  • Never chase losses.
  • Don't bet under the influence of alcohol or emotions.
  • Only use legal, licensed bookmakers.
ui.no_league_matches: No matches in this league today or tomorrow.
ui.ai_note: Team news (injuries, suspensions, motivation, rotation) is researched automatically with AI and turned into model adjustments. The probabilities themselves come from our statistical model.
ui.method_html:
• Attack and defence strength from this season's results, separately for home and away games, with recent matches weighted more.
  • Poisson model with the Dixon-Coles correction for the full score distribution.
  • Elo rating as a second, independent estimate of 1X2 chances.
  • Adjustments for absences (by position and importance of the player), motivation, squad rotation, fatigue and coaching changes.
ui.lineups_unconfirmed: Based on media reports, not official.
ui.value_hint: Value = model probability × best odds. Above 1.05 the odds are higher than the model's fair price.
